verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a finance SaaS that holds transaction, receipt and employee data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention policies, data deletion, or user or admin controls over either. Session expiry, OAuth scopes and audit logs are adjacent access controls, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
